headline: openGauss Community Version Lifecycle Management Specification
description: Specification for managing the lifecycle of openGauss community versions, including LTS and RCx versions.

itemListElement.name: LTS Version
itemListElement.description: A large-scale rollout version released every 2 years, with 3 years of community support, followed by additional maintenance support by oGSPs.

itemListElement.name: RCx Version
itemListElement.description: A collaborative testing version released every 6 months, with 6 months of community support. The planned and developed features in RCx will be incorporated into the corresponding LTS version.

articleBody.name: Maintenance Support
articleBody.description: CVE, Bugfix, and a small number of new features.

articleBody.name: Extended Support
articleBody.description: Fix 'major' and above CVEs and Bugs.

articleBody.name: Lifecycle End Notification
articleBody.description: Notification via email and announcement 3 months before the end of a single version lifecycle.
